phase_name: CI honesty: flush the stale PR queue
note: Phase 8 lands or closes the stale open-PR queue serially. INTERPOSED ship 2 of 2: the image-width GUARD, which makes the PR #178 defect class unrepeatable. Ship 1 (PR #183) was the one-line production repair and is scoped separately so it was not held behind guard review. This ship folds eleven /code-review findings, including a fail-open walk, an unguarded quality half, and a scanner that counted doc examples as call sites. scripts/audit-images.mjs is in scope because its comment/string stripper was extracted to scripts/lib/stripSource.mjs and shared rather than copied. Note that listing .claude/arc-state.json here would be a no-op: DECLARED_ALWAYS_EXEMPT filters it out of the candidate set before the declared-scope match runs. src/pages/OrganiserProfile.tsx appears in scope because this branch is STACKED on fix/organiser-thumb-image-width (PR #183): until that merges, the one-line repair is part of this branch's diff against main. It is declared rather than hidden -- the PR targets the fix branch, and GitHub retargets it to main once #183 lands. REVIEW ROUND 2 added src/pages/VendorDashboardPage.tsx: review found the shared stripper treated every quote as a string opener, so an apostrophe in JSX text or a quote inside a regex literal blanked the rest of the file (15 of 531 files partly unscanned -- the guard reporting ok over code it never read). Fixing that un-blinded audit-images.mjs too, which then found a real with no loading attribute in that page and reds AUDIT_STRICT. The attribute fix pulled the file into ship scope, which pulled four pre-existing `any` uses into the scoped eslint gate; they are narrowed to a local ErrorLike rather than suppressed.
